THE BRAND STRUCTURE
Personal voice: Bonga Bhengu — Healing • Learn • Rebuild
Fashion practice: DONLEGEND — contemporary African fashion and craft
Creative studio: Innovative AI Design — Designing the Future with AI
Keep the three names distinct, with Bonga as the person connecting them.

PERSONAL PROFILE
Display name: Bonga Bhengu | Fashion & AI
Short bio:
Healing • Learn • Rebuild. Durban fashion designer, educator & AI creative. Hope, craft and new beginnings.

LinkedIn headline:
Fashion Designer & Creative Entrepreneur | DONLEGEND | Innovative AI Design | Fashion Education, Brand Identity & AI Visuals

About:
I’m Bonga Bhengu, a Durban-based fashion designer, educator and creative entrepreneur. My experience spans fashion design, pattern making, garment construction, production, business ownership and developing emerging designers.

My work brings African identity and practical craft together through DONLEGEND. Through Innovative AI Design, I explore luxury branding, fashion concepts and visual storytelling with AI tools. I began my self-taught AI journey in 2023 and continue to learn through practical creative work.

Healing • Learn • Rebuild is my personal message: make space for hope, stay curious and take purposeful steps forward. Mindset is Power.

Explore my work and prepare a project brief at:
https://bonga-bhengu.donlegendwear.chatgpt.site/
Business enquiries: bongabhengu@yahoo.com | 081 774 6377

INNOVATIVE AI DESIGN PROFILE
Display name: Innovative AI Design
Tagline: Designing the Future with AI
Short bio:
Innovative AI Design. Luxury logos, brand identities, fashion concepts & social visuals. Designing the Future with AI.

About:
Innovative AI Design is Bonga Bhengu’s creative studio for bold identities, fashion concepts and visual stories. We combine a designer’s eye with AI exploration to develop logo concepts, brand direction, social graphics, campaign imagery, product mockup direction and digital artwork.

The visual language is luxury, bold, futuristic and considered: matte black, metallic gold, platinum and white. Human judgment guides the creative work.

Share your idea and prepare a project brief:
https://bonga-bhengu.donlegendwear.chatgpt.site/#ai-studio

DONLEGEND PROFILE
Display name: DONLEGEND | Bonga Bhengu
Short bio:
DONLEGEND by Bonga Bhengu. Contemporary African fashion, expressive denim & considered craft. Durban, South Africa.

About:
DONLEGEND brings African identity into contemporary fashion through collection development, garment construction and creative direction. Led by Bonga Bhengu in Durban, the practice explores expressive denim, considered materials and clothing with identity.
Discover the practice: https://bonga-bhengu.donlegendwear.chatgpt.site/#practice

30-DAY LAUNCH PLAN

DAYS 1–3 — MAKE THE PROFILES CONSISTENT
Confirm which existing Facebook, LinkedIn and YouTube accounts you control.
Review Instagram, TikTok, X and Pinterest account links before adding them.
Choose the correct display name and bio for each account.
Use one contact email and the website as the central link.
Apply the personal identity to Bonga’s pages; use the gold AI logo on the studio’s pages.
Check the cover and profile icon on mobile before publishing.

DAYS 4–7 — INTRODUCE THE NEXT CHAPTER
Publish and pin the relevant welcome post on the account you control.
Share one original garment/process image and one clearly labelled AI concept.
Ask one specific question: “Which design detail would you like me to explore next?”
Reply thoughtfully to the comments you receive.

WEEK 2 — SHOW THE CRAFT
Post 1: A garment detail. Caption: “A strong silhouette begins with careful construction. Here is one detail behind the idea.” Add the actual material and construction information.
Post 2: A short process clip. Explain one useful step in pattern making, cutting or stitching.
Post 3: A personal reflection. Caption: “Learning keeps the next chapter open. What skill are you working on this week?”

WEEK 3 — SHOW THE AI EXPLORATION
Post 1: One labelled AI fashion concept. Caption: “An AI concept study from Innovative AI Design. I’m exploring [silhouette], [material] and [detail]. Which direction should I develop further?” Replace every bracket with the actual concept.
Post 2: A palette study. Explain why you chose the colours and show a real example.
Post 3: A useful prompt tip. Invite people to try the website’s prompt composer.

WEEK 4 — INVITE A CONVERSATION
Post 1: A brand identity study, clearly labelled as a concept when it is not client work.
Post 2: A Healing • Learn • Rebuild social card with a short personal reflection.
Post 3: A direct invitation: “Working on a fashion collection, brand identity or AI visual idea? Prepare a short brief on my website and contact me to discuss it.”

DAY 30 — REVIEW WHAT PEOPLE RESPONDED TO
Record posts published, profile visits, website visits, saves and qualified enquiries using the analytics available in your own accounts.
Compare actual results with the start of the month. Keep the formats that produce useful conversations and improve the ones people ignore.
No growth target or engagement rate has been invented in this kit.

OPTIONAL WEEKLY TOPICS
Monday: Logo or brand identity study
Tuesday: Fashion concept or garment detail
Wednesday: Behind the process
Thursday: Before/after creative development
Friday: A project or service invitation
Saturday: One focused community question
Sunday: Healing • Learn • Rebuild reflection
Use the topics as a menu; start with three useful posts per week if daily posting is impractical.
